55f2d3fd4bdc2d5f408b4567 Description:
Zona industrială și facilitățile Uzinei Chimice Nr. 16 au fost închiriate ilegal companiei TerraGroup.La începutul Războaielor Contractelor uzina a fost martoră la numeroasă bătălii între USEC și BEAR, bătălii care au determinat în cele din urmă controlul asupra zonei industriale Tarkov.

Mai târziu, în urma haosului, clădiri cheie ale uzinei au devenit adăpost pentru civilii rămași, Gunoieri și militari, incluzând rămășițe ale contingentelor BEAR și USEC.
56db0b3bd2720bb0678b4567 Description: O arenă improvizată pentru lupte între gladiatori, construită de localnicii rămași în centrul comercial Equator-2.
56f40101d2720b2a4d8b45d6 Description: O zona mare a parcului industrial situată adiacent Uzinei. Zona găzduiește un post vamal, depozite de combustibil, birouri și cămine dar și o varietate de alte mici clădiri plus infrastructură.
5704e3c2d2720bac5b8b4567 Description: The Priozersk Nature Reserve recently became part of the state-protected wildlife reserves of the North-Western Federal District.
5704e47ed2720bb35b8b4568 Description: Localitatea Verkhneye este un mic oraș situat pe malul marii, apreciat de localnici că fiind un loc excepțional pentru grădinărit și activități recreative în aer liber.
5704e4dad2720bb55b8b4567 Description: Farul de la Capul Dalniy a fost un obiectiv strategic important pe drumul către Tarkov. Pe vremea Războiului Contractelor, era punctul de intrare principal pentru unitățile USEC și a deservit că baza lor de operațiuni. După conflict, acest loc le-a fost pe plac Gunoierilor dar numai până când vechii proprietari s-au întors, aceștia au decis să rămână în Tarkov și să își stabilească propria lor rânduială.
5704e554d2720bac5b8b456e Description:
The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port.

The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities.

Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.
5704e5a4d2720bb45b8b4567 Description: O parte semnificativă din zona portuară, se zvonește că ar fi punctul de extracție secundar al Emercom.
5704e5fad2720bc05b8b4567 Description: Baza secretă a Rezervei Agenției Federale de Stat care, conform legendelor urbane, conține provizii suficiente pentru mulți ani: hrană, medicamente, și alte bunuri de necesitate, suficiente pentru a supraviețui unui război nuclear.
5704e64ad2720bb55b8b456e Description: Complexul rezidential privat este format din cabanele si vilele cetatenilor instariti din Tarkov. In primele saptamani de la declansarea haousului, locatia a servit ca si baza de coordonare pentru refugiati. Locul este acum frecventat de Gunoieri.
5714dbc024597771384a510d Description: Intersecția Sud reprezintă un nod cheie pentru infrastructura de transport a orașului. Această zonă strategică face legătură între port și debarcadere și zonele industriale aferente orașului Tarkov. În centrul intersecției se află complexul comercial ULTRA care a fost folosit ca și bază principală de operațiuni în timpul evacuării EMERCOM.
5714dc342459777137212e0b Description: Suburbia Tarkov este o zona locuită în special de navetiști, posedă toată infrastructură și confortul necesar pentru o viață lungă și fericită.
5714dc692459777137212e12 Description: Centrul este principala zona financiară și comercială a orașului Tarkov. Zona include hoteluri, bănci, complexe comerciale dar și alte facilități specifice unei metropole înfloritoare.
599319c986f7740dca3070a6 Description: O arenă improvizată pentru lupte între gladiatori, construită de localnicii rămași în centrul comercial Equator-2.
59fc81d786f774390775787e Description:
Zona industrială și facilitățile Uzinei Chimice Nr. 16 au fost închiriate ilegal companiei TerraGroup.La începutul Războaielor Contractelor uzina a fost martoră la numeroasă bătălii între USEC și BEAR, bătălii care au determinat în cele din urmă controlul asupra zonei industriale Tarkov.

Mai târziu, în urma haosului, clădiri cheie ale uzinei au devenit adăpost pentru civilii rămași, Gunoieri și militari, incluzând rămășițe ale contingentelor BEAR și USEC.
5b0fc42d86f7744a585f9105 Description: Laboratoarele TerraGroup sunt un complex subteran secret ascuns chiar sub centrul orașului Tarkov. Oficial acest centru de cercetare nu există, dar pe baza puținelor informații disponibile acest complex este folosit pentru cercetare și dezvoltare cât și pentru simulări și testări ale proiectelor avansate în domeniul fizic, chimic și biologic.
61e800b841ee214fbf1f0e53 Description: An abandoned terminal hangar, borrowed by locals to become one of the death arenas.
621df90bf200a905ed57d31d Description: A makeshift arena for gladiator fights, redesigned by remaining locals out of Equator-2 shopping mall.
62a05c960a18b50b7c575b1b Description: A former TerraGroup Labs guarded cargo storage section in the harbor area.
62a20c387949e8388b2f97c8 Description: An old private sawmill between the city and the suburbs. It was rumored to be a TerraGroup Labs reserve covert command center with an autonomous control system.
62eba95b7ba21c1d534d305a Description: A bowl of the old sports arena with stands, converted for death-fighting.
6441004f8ab20b218807f14b Description: A car chop shop on the outskirts of Tarkov. It used to be a place where stolen cars were dismantled for parts, but now it's used to host firefights.
64b7d7f23d81c8a9ee03ac27 Description: A courtyard in one of the residential neighborhoods, re-equipped for Arena fights.
653e6760052c01c1c805532f Description: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began.
65b8d6f5cdde2479cb2a3125 Description: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began. The area has yet again become a hot zone since the early days of the conflict.
65cc8f81a9aac3e77d0cfd3e Description: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.
662b728d328cb632bd0c6caf Description: The railway station, whose trains connected Tarkov with other cities in the Norvinsk region, was opened after reconstruction on the eve of the conflict. It is now used as an arena for battles.
6690e7e7dc976e4c780336b1 Description: A 19th century sea fort, which by fate became a prison at first and then after a century got turned into an arena for gladiatorial fights.
6733700029c367a3d40b02af Description: A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park.
68236e8153654e8c1200798a Description: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began.
6925a2c38bdebd9e2302692e Description: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.
69af492a4819ea4ba10a69c5 Description:
In the Gulf of Finland, trapped within the blockade surrounding Tarkov, lies the nuclear-powered icebreaker "Boreas", owned by the logistics corporation Paradigm Shipping. The exact purpose of "Boreas" and the cargo it carries remain unknown. 

It appears that Paradigm Shipping and TerraGroup made special efforts to minimize any mention of the icebreaker in the press and keep its routes and assignments classified.
6a294a5b5eb5f9a1700417b7 Description: Laboratoarele TerraGroup sunt un complex subteran secret ascuns chiar sub centrul orașului Tarkov. Oficial acest centru de cercetare nu există, dar pe baza puținelor informații disponibile acest complex este folosit pentru cercetare și dezvoltare cât și pentru simulări și testări ale proiectelor avansate în domeniul fizic, chimic și biologic.
5464e0404bdc2d2a708b4567 Description: Compania militară privată USEC a fost înființată în 1999 prin fuziunea a două companii: KerniSEC și Safe Sea. În 2004, un agent al TerraGroup a luat legătură cu USEC, USEC devenind ulterior armata privată a grupului cu peste 7500 de angajați și birouri în toată lumea.
5464e0454bdc2d06708b4567 Description: Compania militară privată BEAR a fost creată printr-un decret secret a Guvernului Federației Ruse, ca măsură împotriva activităților ilegale ale TerraGroup pe teritoriul Rusiei.
5803a58524597710ca36fcb2 Description: TerraGroup este o companie multinațională formată din subsidiare cu o gamă largă de domenii de activitate. TG cuprinde peste 40 de mari întreprinderi, având sucursale în peste 120 de țări în întreaga lume.
5805f617245977100b2c1f41 Description: O companie privată din Regatul Unit (PLC), subsidiară corporației TerraGroup Internațional Holding. Oficial domeniul de activitate este cercetarea științifică în domeniul biotehnologii aplicate în industria agroalimentară și agricultură.
5807be8924597742c603fa19 Description: Tarkov este un oraș situat în nord-vestul Rusiei, o entitate municipală din regiunea Norvinsk, și este unul din cele două orașe principale din Zona Economică Specială Norvinsk.
5807bfe124597742a92e0a4c Description: Un teritoriu delimitat aflat în regiunea Norvinsk, ce include orașele Norvinsk și Tarkov împreună cu infrastructura locală și care posedă un statut legal special în relație cu restul Rusiei, o zonă economică privilegiată pentru întreprinderile naționale și străine.
5807c3f124597746bf2db2ce Description: Din haosul și fărădelegea, lipsa proviziilor și lupta pentru teritoriu, primii care-și ridică capul sunt personajele dubioase imune la excesele imorale și fără restrângeri etice împreună cu cei care le pierd imediat ce intră sub influență condițiilor ostile. Se adună în haite trăind după regulă "care-pe-care" și sunt gata să-și taie găturile pentru o bucată mai mare. Astfel civilii de ieri devin Gunoieri.
5c1b857086f77465f465faa4 Description:
Un grup de indivizi înarmați, după zvonuri ar fi formați din foști mercenari din companiile militare private și rezidenți locali.
Au o bună pregătire în abilități de luptă și tactică.
63a9c1f5662a5b0a2c7fbde5 Description: Tarkov este un oraș situat în nord-vestul Rusiei, municipiu din regiunea Norvinsk, și este unul din cele două orașe principale din Zona Economică Specială Norvinsk.
64c0acf85174e095610734a0 Description: Sherpas are players who help beginners study the main game features and improve their skills to survive the harsh Tarkov environment. This difficult and honorable task falls on the shoulders of the most friendly, patient, and experienced players.
64c0ad6af99768b777048f4e Description: Emissaries are volunteers from all over the world who are actively involved in the Escape from Tarkov community and support Battlestate Games. Emissaries create content, make sure every voice in the community is heard, and make official messages clear and accessible to players anywhere in the world.
6724cde3b1130abeee0c3db7 Description: Rumors have spread around Tarkov about a leak from the TerraGroup Laboratory. Residents affected by the substance have shown sudden changes in behavior and bouts of aggression. The number of casualties is rapidly increasing. With this new threat endangering the entire city, conflicts between the factions in Tarkov have significantly decreased. It's possible that the leaders of each side have agreed to a temporary truce.
67d135bc9e0d93daf71d555e Description: A large area of industrial park land situated adjacent to the factory zone. The area houses a customs terminal, fuel storage facilities, offices, and dorms, as well as a variety of other infrastructure and buildings.
67d13656443d3073a3a92427 Description: The industrial estate and facilities of Chemical Plant No. 16 (Polikhim) were rented out illegally to the TerraGroup corporation. During the advent of the Contract Wars, the plant became the scene of numerous firefights between BEAR and USEC that ultimately determined control over the industrial district of Tarkov.
67d1abc6c5fbfe1a95025e93 Description: The South Interchange is a key transport location for the city. This strategic area connects the port and harbor with the industrial outskirts of Tarkov. Located in the center of the interchange is a huge ULTRA shopping mall which was used as the main base of operation for the EMERCOM evacuation.
67d1ac1a2fb6a5d11b09d6f8 Description: The lighthouse at Cape Dalniy was an important strategic object on the way to Tarkov. During Contract Wars, it was the main entry point for USEC units and served as their base of operations. After the conflict, Scavs took a fancy to this place, until the old owners returned, who decided to stay in Tarkov and establish their own order.
67d1ac705df2d64de808e1d2 Description: The secret Federal State Reserve Agency base that, according to urban legends, contains enough supplies to last for years: food, medications, and other resources, enough to survive an all-out nuclear war.
67d1ac822b87c1a5a30e5ae8 Description: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began.
67d1ac995df2d64de808e1d6 Description:
The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port.

Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.
67d1acbf5df2d64de808e1d8 Description: Downtown Tarkov houses banks, malls, and hotels, as well as all the other amenities a thriving metropolis could have needed.
67d1acda2fb6a5d11b09d6fd Description: The Priozersk Nature Reserve recently became part of the state-protected wildlife reserves of the North-Western Federal District.
67d1ad1b5df2d64de808e1da Description: Secret underground TerraGroup Labs facility hidden right under the center of Tarkov. 67e3f71e445e18765a052687 Description: A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park.

But among PMC operators, very few believe in the existence of this so-called “Black Division”, because under the current circumstances, freely inserting and extracting entire combat groups through the blockade ring is practically impossible.

Even Scavs have their own code. Fence makes sure it's respected, and he can make life very difficult for anyone who chooses to ignore it.

The first and most important rule – Scavs don't shoot their own!
At least not first.

To increase your Fence reputation, complete his tasks, use vehicle and co-op extractions, successfully extract from raids, and eliminate hostile PMCs while playing as a Scav.

616041eb031af660100c9967 successMessageT: Undă verde deci? Treaba bună, soldat.
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 54c: Ah, luptător. Ascultă, am nevoie de ajutor cu observarea unei zone - va trebui să faci o plimbare prin niște locuri, să vezi care-i situația acolo, poate găsești niște cai de scăpare. Nu pe gratis - vei primi răsplată, desigur. Bun, fă-ți bagajul, vom aștepta vești de la tine.
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Cum adică refuzi? Soldat, soldat... folosește-ți căpățână: cine va apăra Patria dacă nu tu? Mai gândește-te o dată.
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 54c: Salutări, tinere. Angajații mei au de livrat niște loturi de medicamente valoroase, dar sunt precaut și nu vreau să-i trimit singuri fără să știu dacă ruta e sigură. Dacă ești disponibil atunci te rog să ne ajuți, pentru binelele civililor. Trebuie doar să cercetezi zona și să asiguri că au trecerea liberă. Te bagi?
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Tinere, nu-i momentul să iei decizii în grabă. Gândește-te puțin, cântărește opțiunile. Totuși nu zăbovi prea mult - treaba e urgentă, altfel va trebui să caut un angajat mai bun dacă mă refuzi.
616041eb031af660100c9967 successMessageT: Deci, cum e situația? Buun, totul merge bine atunci.
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 583: Vino-ncoa, domu' operator, să vorbim. Cum ești, băiete, ocupat? Nu ești ocupat deci. Am nevoie să cercetezi o zona că să-mi meargă treburile bine. Mergi și vezi care-i situația, bine? Nu vreau că oamenii mei să se bată cu nimeni. Deci da, hai înapoi când ai terminat. Voi fi aici.
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Ce, te-ai căcat pe tine? Mă gândeam că n-ai coaie pentru treaba asta. Bine, dacă ești așa pizdă, îți dau altceva de făcut.
616041eb031af660100c9967 successMessageT: Buun, buun. Te-ai descurcat bine, mercenare. Ești liber să pleci.
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 593: Ah, mercenare, vrei să faci o fapta bună? Clienții îmi cer să le garantez o zona sigură pentru o operațiune specifică secretă. Te-aș numi pe ține, din moment ce ești cel mai competent dintre operatorii locali. Va trebui să observi ce-i în zona și apoi să-mi raportezi. Bafta, mercenar.
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Nu vreau să-mi pierd timpul căutând alt operator. Ești sigur, mercenare, că vrei să mă pui într-o situație dificilă?
616041eb031af660100c9967 successMessageT: Bun, aici e harta, arată-mi ce-ai găsit. Bun, o să le transmit clienților. Mulțumesc, prietene.
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 5a7: Mercenare, ai un minut? Am pregătit o comandă pentru clienți, dar vor să le garantez că punctul de întâlnire e sigur. Dacă n-ai altă treaba, le poți găsi o ruta? Găsește o intrare sigură și o cale de ieșire, mă înțelegi? Mulțumesc, rămân dator.
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Mare păcat. Am ținut special să-ți cer ție să faci misiunea asta... Chiar a început să-mi placă să lucrez cu tine. Nu te grăbi să refuzi totuși, ok? Poate se schimbă lucrurile.
616041eb031af660100c9967 successMessageT: Minunat, frate! N-am să uit asta!
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 5ac: Salut, frate, am niște lucruri de rezolvat. Sunt niște băieți pe care vreau neapărat să-i întâlnesc ca să discutăm niște chestii, dar băieții ăștia sunt foarte timizi și nu vor să se bage în mizeriile mele. Mă poți ajută cu treaba asta? Caută-le doar o ruta sigură pe unde să nu-i deranjeze nimeni. Bun?
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Uite ce mofturos. "Pe asta o fac, pe asta nu". Adineaori te bucurai la orice misiune tip "găsește și predă" pe care ți-o dădeam. Mă, nu te uită la mine de parcă mint!
616041eb031af660100c9967 successMessageT: Bine, cred că-i timpul să te duci. Mulțumesc, tinere.
616041eb031af660100c9967 description 5c0: Hai înăuntru la niște ceai, tinere. Mă pregătesc să ies la vânătoare azi și mi-ar prinde bine să am niște informații despre zona. Poți să mergi să verifici? Rămân dator.
616041eb031af660100c9967 changeQuestMess: Mda, știi, în timp ce-ți explicam situația, am văzut în ochii tăi că nu prea ești hotărât dacă vrei sau nu misiunea. Ce neplăcut, va trebui să caut alt om pentru treaba asta.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 successMessageT: Aici erai! Ai la tine tot? Treabă bună.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 54c: Salut, hai înăuntru. Ști cumva de un loc magic în care găsești întotdeauna ce ai nevoie? Am o comandă pentru niște bunuri, și n-am nici cea mai mică idee unde să le găsesc. Vrei să mă ajuți? Pentru o recompensă, evident.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Cum adică refuzi? Soldat, soldat... folosește-ți căpățână: cine va apăra Patria dacă nu tu? Mai gândește-te o dată.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 successMessageT: Ai făcut o faptă bună, mercenar.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 54c: Bună ziua, tinere. În vremurile astea tulburi, e cam greu să rămâi în abundență, cred că ești de acord. Am primit o comandă pentru niște bunuri specifice, dar nu pot să le obțin. Ne poți ajută, mercenare? Aici ai lista de bunuri.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Tinere, nu-i momentul să iei decizii în grabă. Gândește-te puțin, cântărește opțiunile. Totuși nu zăbovi prea mult - treaba e urgentă, altfel va trebui să caut un angajat mai bun dacă mă refuzi.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 successMessageT: Aici e săgeata! Te-ai descurcat bine omule.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 583: Vreo să cauți niște bunătăți? Trebuie să fac rost de niște lucruri, dar toți oamenii mei sunt prinși cu treburi mai importante. Tu, în schimb, abia aștepți să ajuți un prieten! Hai'ncoa, să-ți fac o lista. Spor la treabă.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Ce, te-ai căcat pe tine? Mă gândeam că n-ai coaie pentru treaba asta. Bine, dacă ești așa pizdă, îți dau altceva de făcut.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 593: Bună ziua. Am o comandă pentru niște bunuri pe care Căștile Albastre nu le pot obține. Dar, te avem pe tine, mercenare, și abilitățile tale, va fi floare la ureche pentru tine. Aici ai lista de bunuri. Nu mă dezamăgi.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Nu vreau să-mi pierd timpul căutând alt operator. Ești sigur, mercenare, că vrei să mă pui într-o situație dificilă?
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 5a7: Salut, mercenar. Ascultă, am o comandă pentru diferite provizii, dar nu le am pe toate în stoc acum. Aș fi extrem de recunoscător dacă te-ai duce să faci rost de ele pentru mine. Aici ai lista cu toate informațiile. Mulțumesc.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Mare păcat. Am ținut special să-ți cer ție să faci misiunea asta... Chiar a început să-mi placă să lucrez cu tine. Nu te grăbi să refuzi totuși, ok? Poate se schimbă lucrurile.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 successMessageT: Ah, ce jucător, gata să sară în ajutor!
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 5ac: Salut, frate. Am o listă plină cu bunuri speciale de livrat, iar clienții tot așteaptă. Poți merge să le cauți și să-ți ajuți fratele Arshavir?
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Uite ce mofturos. "Pe asta o fac, pe asta nu". Adineaori te bucurai la orice misiune tip "găsește și predă" pe care ți-o dădeam. Mă, nu te uită la mine de parcă mint!
61604635c725987e815b1a46 successMessageT: Mulțumesc, băiete, bună treabă. Uite, pentru deranj.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 description 5c0: Salut, tinere. Am cam rămas fără provizii, pentru magazin, pentru mine. Mă poți ajuta? Așteptă aici, îți fac o listă. Mulțumesc.
61604635c725987e815b1a46 changeQuestMess: Mda, știi, în timp ce-ți explicam situația, am văzut în ochii tăi că nu prea ești hotărât dacă vrei sau nu misiunea. Ce neplăcut, va trebui să caut alt om pentru treaba asta.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f successMessageT: Ai eliminat bastarzii? Buun, aici e bonusul tău.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f description 54c: Salutari, soldat, am o treabă pentru tine. Sunt niște idioți cu care nu vreau să-mi mai bat capul. Genul de muncă potrivită pentru tine. Mă poți ajuta? Elimină idioții, stai să-ți dau lista de nume.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f changeQuestMess: Cum adică refuzi? Soldat, soldat... folosește-ți căpățână: cine va apăra Patria dacă nu tu? Mai gândește-te o dată.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f successMessageT: Gata misiunea? Bun, aici ai plata.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f description 54c: Mercenare, la fix. Avem nevoie de ajutor cu eliminarea unui grup de bandiți care ne încurcă operațiunile umanitare. Dacă nu ești ocupat, atunci îți ofer ție misiunea. Toate detaliile sunt incluse.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f changeQuestMess: Tinere, nu-i momentul să iei decizii în grabă. Gândește-te puțin, cântărește opțiunile. Totuși nu zăbovi prea mult - treaba e urgentă, altfel va trebui să caut un angajat mai bun dacă mă refuzi.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f successMessageT: Ești bestial, haha. Bună treabă, aici e partea ta.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f description 583: A ajuns, singurul și unicul! Ascultă, frate, suntem prieteni, corect? Și prietenii la nevoie se cunosc! Așa că hai și ajută-mă - trebuie să le crapi capu' la niște dobitoci, nu pui întrebări, ok? Te bagi?
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f changeQuestMess: Ce, te-ai căcat pe tine? Mă gândeam că n-ai coaie pentru treaba asta. Bine, dacă ești așa pizdă, îți dau altceva de făcut.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f successMessageT: Treabă bună, prietene! Aici ai plata.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f description 593: Mercenare, asta-i o treabă pentru tine. Căștile Albastre vor fi recunoscătoare dacă reușești să ne întărești relațiile. Este o listă cu niște personaje fără de care afacerea noastră ar merge mult mai bine. Scapă de ei și raportează-mi când ai terminat.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f changeQuestMess: Nu vreau să-mi pierd timpul căutând alt operator. Ești sigur, mercenare, că vrei să mă pui într-o situație dificilă?
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f successMessageT: Frumos, frumos. Uite, ia asta, un mic cadou.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f description 5ac: Tre' să fac ceva... Ah, selam, frate. Ascultă, poți să ajuți un frate? Băieții mei s-au băgat în belea cu niște căcănari. Au murit mulți băieți buni, dar cel mai rău lucru, căcănarii aia au furat toate țoalele! Nu pot să-i las în pace acum, corect? Du-te și fă-le felu'.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f changeQuestMess: Uite ce mofturos. "Pe asta o fac, pe asta nu". Adineaori te bucurai la orice misiune tip "găsește și predă" pe care ți-o dădeam. Mă, nu te uită la mine de parcă mint!
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f successMessageT: Deci nu vor altceva decât să se împuște între ei. E greșit. Bine, băiete, știu că ai încercat.
616051e63f96cc089c1cf37f description 5c0: Știi tu, nu putem curăța singuri Tarkovu de paraziții ăștia distructivi. Dar ce putem face e să le dăm o lecție și să-i lăsăm să-și dea seama de greșelile lor indiferent de cât de inumane sunt. Și dacă bandiții aia nu vor să vorbească - atunci pot să-i trimiți direct în iad.

6180385770bf5a029372b9aa description 54c: Bună ziua, tinere. Ești în măsură să ne ajuți? Momentan îngrijim mai mulți pacienți cu răni grave și nu vom putea să-i evacuăm prin forțe proprii. Trebuie să-i transferăm din oraș până într-un punct de unde pot fi luați și duși la spital. Cum adică? Nu, nu va trebui să-i cari în spate. Va trebui doar să cercetezi zona, ruta pe care am ales-o pentru evacuare.

6180385770bf5a029372b9aa description 583: Bun, deschide urechile, direct la subiect. Am nevoie să ieși la plimbare undeva și să verifici dacă locul e sigur și din alea.

6180385770bf5a029372b9aa description 593: Salut, soldat! Ești pregătit să ajuți poporul? Obiectivele mari încep cu pași mici. Cercetează zona marcată și găsește puncte de evacuare, asta va ajuta la salvarea multor vieți.

6180385770bf5a029372b9aa description 5a7: Salut! Ce bine că ești aici. Am comandat niște piese de schimb pentru proiectul meu, vor fi transportate prin zona asta. Poți să mergi să verifici cât e de sigură? N-aș vrea să pierd o asemenea încărcătură degeaba.
6180385770bf5a029372b9aa changeQuestMess: Mare păcat. Am ținut special să-ți cer ție să faci misiunea asta... Chiar a început să-mi placă să lucrez cu tine. Nu te grăbi să refuzi totuși, ok? Poate se schimbă lucrurile.
6180385770bf5a029372b9aa successMessageT: Perfect, frate! Poftim, ia asta, o să-ți fie utilă.
6180385770bf5a029372b9aa description 5ac: Intră, fra'! Cum merge treaba? Tocmai ce planific o afacere mare. Dracu' știe pe unde să duc marfa - colcăie toată zona cu Scavi... Uite, vezi și tu pe hartă. Ai fost pe-aici recent? Poți să mergi să verifici situația, ajuți și tu un frate, da?

6180385770bf5a029372b9aa successMessageT: Am înțeles. Poftim, pentru ajutorul acordat.
6180385770bf5a029372b9aa description 5c0: Mă bucur ca-i trecut pe-aici. Nu prea mai vin oaspeți. Aș fi fost și eu în pământ dacă nu știam să vânez. Împachetez pentru o vânătoare mâine. Poți să verifici parcul? Îți arăt pe harta unde am de mers, n-aș vrea să-mi iau glonț. Mă gândesc că vederea ta e mult mai bună decât a mea, băiete. Spune-mi tot ce descoperi. Doamne-ajută.

6180385770bf5a029372b9ab successMessageT: Mulțumesc, camarade! Țara nu va uita.
6180385770bf5a029372b9ab description 54c: Unde dracu e... Tot timpul e așa, rămâi fără piese chiar când ai nevoie de ele... Hei, soldat! Pot să mă ajuți să căutăm ceva?
6180385770bf5a029372b9ab changeQuestMess: Cum adică refuzi? Soldat, soldat... folosește-ți căpățână: cine va apăra Patria dacă nu tu? Mai gândește-te o dată.

6180385770bf5a029372b9ab description 593: Mercenare, trebuie să-ți cer ajutorul. Clienții mei au nevoie de bunurile astea dar, din varii motive, nu pot să dau un ordin oficial pentru aprovizionare.

6180385770bf5a029372b9ab description 5ac: Fra, vrei să-i ajuți pe băieții buni? Uite, am o comandă de la ei. Trebuie să găsești tot ce e pe lista. Nu, nu-i foarte urgent.

6891bb83d7502d512502d160_Note_Page1_Text: Tarkov News Issue #142 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ Escalation in Tarkov The military conflict in Tarkov continues to escalate. Eyewitnesses remaining in the city report increasing clashes between BEAR and USEC units. UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces are cordoning off dangerous areas, but these zones are growing, and according to unconfirmed reports, high-level discussions are already underway regarding a potential full lockdown of the city. Both PMC groups likely still maintain their supply channels for weapons and personnel, which is why almost no one is willing to make optimistic forecasts. Evacuation of civilians is difficult, and both sides are organizing humanitarian aid drops to help local residents hold out until safe corridors open. Amid the crisis, local criminal groups are also becoming more active. In some cases, these groups manage to seize weapons and take control of parts of the city. Currently, three such areas are known. In the city center, the criminal gang of a former entrepreneur, known by the alias "Kaban", has established a fortified base in the former LexOs car dealership. According to recent data, PMC units have unsuccessfully attempted to dislodge the gang several times. An anonymous source told the editorial team that Kaban possesses samples of heavy weaponry that cannot even be obtained on the black market. Some experts suggest a possible connection between Kaban and the nonprofit organization "Forward Movement", which was previously linked in a high-profile case involving deputy minister of economy Yaroslav Shkurenko and the criminal authority nicknamed Chepyga. Near the customs terminal, the "Zavodskoy" gang, previously involved in petty thefts in the district, has been spotted. Eyewitnesses report ongoing gunfire in that area. EMERCOM units were forced to abandon evacuation points near the "Ultra" mall due to increased attacks by armed groups that took control of one floor of the mall. EMERCOM tents at the nearby highway interchange are no longer safe. EMERCOM recommendations remain the same: first, find a secure shelter and wait for evacuation there, provide aid to the wounded if possible, and avoid venturing onto city streets. We hope that UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces will take more decisive measures to cool the conflict in Tarkov and will continue reporting all important developments. ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ HUMANITARIAN AID POINTS BY TARKOV DISTRICTS Komsomolsky District Ordzhonikidze Ave, 3. 689b52d6886e9848a4085917_Note_Page1_Text: HIGHLY CLASSIFIED DESTROY AFTER READING Purpose and characteristics Item #1156 — an aerosol augmenter of radio-frequency electromagnetic emission (RF-EMI), designed to neutralize enemy electronic equipment over a large area. The item can be used on its own or as the warhead component of delivery systems (tactical, operational-tactical, and medium range). Weight: 37.080 kg Dimensions: 2500*800*800 Effect radius: 15 to 40 km depending on medium density Activation: 1. Remote initiation using a timed/distance fuze (up to 200m) / 2. Remote initiation via radio communication (within the radio’s operational range) General design The shock-wave emitter operates by means of spherically symmetric compression of the electromagnetic field. The fuze consists of a magnetic system that directs magnetic poles to the center of a sphere formed by two intersecting magnetic flux rings. Inside the magnetic flux sphere is a detonation distributor, made from a plastic sphere with 45 channels filled with an initiating high explosive (lead azide was tested). The channel system ensures simultaneous arrival of the detonation wave at the main explosive charge. At the center of the detonation distributor is the main explosive charge (tested mixtures included trotyl-hexogen combinations, octogen, and tetryl). Embedded in the center of the main charge is a cesium iodide single crystal treated with mixture #3012. Features Using spherically symmetric compression of the electromagnetic field together with treatment of the cesium iodide single crystal with mixture #3012 provides a significant increase in pulse efficiency compared to known EMI weapon prototypes. Measurements taken during testing showed retention of 40 to 50% of the explosive energy. #: 2 Signature ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲
689b52d6886e9848a4085917_Note_Page2_Text: HIGHLY CLASSIFIED DESTROY AFTER READING Upon detonation of Item #1156 a high-frequency magnetic field is generated that establishes a standing spatial RF-EMI wave. This substantially reduces the effectiveness of EMI protection by shielding and increases the disabling effect of Item #1156. During tests a blue glow was also observed. The cause of this effect has not yet been determined. It is hypothesized that the optical phenomenon is similar in nature to ionization of gas molecules, like that which occurs during the aurora borealis. Predicted effects of deployment Use in a large city (Tarkov, Moscow, London, Singapore, etc.) will result in guaranteed power outages across the agglomeration and destruction of electrical equipment within a 15 km radius of detonation, significant damage to electrical equipment in the 15 to 28 km band, and possible damage to electrical equipment in the 28 to 40 km band. For maximum effectiveness, detonation of Item #1156 should be carried out from an elevated position (communications tower, construction crane, high-rise building, etc.). #: 2 Signature ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲

689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page1_Text:
<width=70%>And then the Riders of the Arrival shall appear, and they shall open the door to the New World. All that is old shall die, for only the devoted flock is worthy of transformation and service to The Unheard.

The Wardens shall reap the harvest and carry into the New World the memory of old humanity. The transition to the next stage of evolution is inevitable, and the appearance of the Riders marks the beginning of the division of homo sapiens into two kinds.

They shall no longer be united: each shall be shown their place. Only those among us who follow the path laid out by The Unheard shall be permitted to witness the true flourishing of civilization.

For Their enlightenment is our salvation, and only by Their wisdom can the New World be governed.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


In the decisive hour, the Riders of the Arrival shall emerge from the shadows of corporations and states, yet they shall neither seek aid nor call followers. For we must see the great design ourselves, we must bring an end
to the old world so that from its ashes the New may be born.

Before the face of the coming, fear will compel many to submit to the will of new rulers. But the Rider cannot be deceived. The wisest judgment shall separate the wheat from the chaff, and each shall be repaid according to their deeds. The old truths have long lost their meaning. Only one truth and one purpose remain steadfast amid the ashes of dead ideas – to hasten the birth of the New World and prepare everything for the Great Arrival.</width>
689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page3_Text:
<width=70%>Sunset and dawn, fall and uprising demand Sacrifice! Not become a Sacrifice, but become the executioner’s sword! The weak will perish, and the strong will perish! Only the truly faithful will be allowed to the Door into the future. There, where neurons and bits become one whole.

The Door, the Door, the Door divides past and future, it separates the New and the old world! By the hand of The Unheard it will open, and it will cut away all that is old, all that is needless… The will of The Unheard will determine a new order in which the human species will enter a new phase of development. Phoenix! Rebirth through blood! The new human needs fresh blood!

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


Thoughts do not burn, the thoughts of Man will remain forever and the Wardens will carry thoughts through the purifying flame of true faith! The Old Man will die. The gods will die. <u>Knowledge will live</u>. Knowledge is more important than the heart! More important than blood!

The pinnacle of evolution turned out to be only a step on the path of humanity’s development, all for the sake of the truth that will be revealed to The Unheard! In the name of truth, kill. The truly faithful understand, the others will burn. The others are destined for pain. All who are not ready to be reborn will drown in the fire of pain. The final threshold. Transformation. Purification.</width>
689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page5_Text:
<width=70%>The Priests have access to fragments of The Unheard Knowledge, for they have seen what will be. It was said that the Blue Fire will illuminate our world with a new dawn, and this will be the Dawn of the New World, and then the sacred flame of each was illuminated. The old idols, which humanity followed, lost their former power, and a new order began. The blind burn in the fire of suffering, as foretold, for they do not know the True Path. But the truly faithful turned to the Warden and were promised salvation, for the New Family awaits the New World.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The great transition has begun, and the mighty of this world have become weak, for true power must rise to the top of the Pyramid!

Only Truth will govern the New World, and in its fire, all who cannot grasp it will be consumed. People of the old world see only suffering, but the enlightened see the path and salvation. The blind have turned away from the dawn of the New World, as foretold. They cannot comprehend the blessing of The Unheard Knowledge, and they began to fight to hide the Blue Fire from the world, so that no one would know the Arrival is near!

But they do not know that the Dawn of the New World will cross all boundaries, nor do they know that the truly faithful have seen it from everywhere and have become instruments of The Unheard, for the Arrival cannot be stopped. Where the sun rises, and where it sets, the enlightened have witnessed the great Fire.</width>
689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page6_Text:
<width=70%>The truly faithful must follow the Path shown by The Unheard. For anyone can hasten the Arrival. The products of human thought must be gathered in special places, marked by the devoted.

The birth of the New World is preceded by the death of the old. And for this death to occur, The Unheard need instruments through which the great purification of the human race will take place.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


But the devoted themselves can become the sword that cleaves a path to the New World. By separating the truly faithful from the doomed, even now we can help The Unheard cleanse the old world. The spilled blood of the blind must become a sign from which others will awaken.

Faith is proven only through blood, pain is the touch of The Unheard, blissful and searing, for only through fire can a mortal be reborn, only with flame is the dead burned away! With Blue Fire! The flame will divide all, the flame will reveal everything, and it will reveal the New World.</width>
689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page8_Text:
<width=70%>For those initiated into the plan, The Unheard have prepared a special and singular Path, along which the chosen will be able to enter the New World. Rebirth is ordained for our species, and every new step toward the coming future is marked by the <u>Gift</u>. Each Gift is destined to play its role.

The <u>Blue Fire</u> will become the fire that ignites the entire old world. Dry and dead, the old world must burn to ashes. States will fall, unable to resist the inevitable march of time. The power of rulers will prove to be their curse, for there is no power greater than the power of <s>The Unheard</s> wisdom, and no wisdom higher than the wisdom of The Unheard.

Yet the pinnacle of homo sapien’ history must become the foundation of the New World. All information available to humanity will be sifted through the sieve of the Wardens. Every thought and every action committed by a human will become a cast of the homo sapiens species, for nothing will escape the <u>Eye of the World</u>.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The best that sapiens will leave behind are the pinnacles of thought, which will outlast both this species and this world. Knowledge gave rise to it, and it will also be the engine that will launch a new rebirth. But this time, living thought is destined to become one with artificial thought. True rebirth is a transformation and a merging with a more efficient <u>Higher Mind</u>.

Humanity is incapable, in the truest sense, of mastering time and space. Is that true? – I wouldn’t put it that way. Yes, innovation requires significant energy resources, and our facilities are no exception. Some of our projects demand power plants that simply don’t exist in the region. But the company’s development strategy already includes the construction of next-generation power stations. And we’ve made progress – just two days ago we, hm, reached an agreement with Yaroslav Grigorievich! (editor’s note: Deputy Minister of Economy Shkurenko Y. G.) In the future, Cobalt will bring light to many citizens of Tarkov, and today’s difficulties have only highlighted a problem in the city that we intend to solve. – So you see the problem as lying with the city, not the costs of your projects? Our data suggests Tarkov has never suffered from a power shortage. – Are you asking whether our projects can improve the city’s situation? That’s a great question! And I’ll say this: one of the key reasons for choosing this site was its potential for developing energy infrastructure, and in that regard, Tarkov certainly has room to grow. You have to understand – it’s not about what Tarkov looks like now, it’s about what it will become with us. – Speaking of innovation. We’ve calculated that even taken together, all of Cobalt’s public projects don’t consume that much electricity. It seems Cobalt is planning to increase the city’s power load several times over for a project the people of Tarkov know nothing about. How do you comment on that? – We understand the public’s concern and appreciate the interest in our work! But right now, even a small leak could seriously affect the development process. The walls have ears, right? Too much openness could harm not only Cobalt, but also Russia’s position on the international market. But getting back to Tarkov and its energy infrastructure – we’ve already reached a compromise with the local authorities. Until our new plants are operational, we’ll be "staying over" at state-owned facilities. For now, we’ll have to squeeze into city power plant buildings, but once our stations come online, the people of Tarkov will forget about power shortages entirely. – Well, we’re intrigued by Cobalt’s new project and look forward to hearing more. This has been Yuri Belogorov from Lights of Tarkov, and Nikolay Tretyakov, NGO Cobalt representative in Tarkov.

68d2f400be7c1493b90cd3f7_Note_Page1_Text: #14 Newspaper THE NINTH CIRCLE ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ The Will of Chance Greetings to all survivors. I don’t know what I’d do without being able to talk to you. Sometimes it even feels like the old world never existed, as if everything collapsed into this closed-off city where each of us has just one mission – to make it through to tomorrow. But today, I want to share a story that gives me hope for a better outcome. Maybe it will help you too. Yesterday I went to check on a wounded friend and met a gloomy, withdrawn BEAR sitting in Therapist’s recovery room, clutching a USEC patch in his hands. At first glance, it seemed obvious: a trophy from a heavy fight where he lost a comrade. He’d avenged him, sure, but that hadn’t brought him peace. So there he sat, angry at himself for not being able to double-tap that USEC in time. Still, I decided to strike up a conversation, and from his first words, I realized all my guesses were wrong. This BEAR had been scouting a new route to TerraGroup’s underground lab when his squad discovered an elevator shaft in critical condition. They managed to reach the complex through it and complete their mission, but on the way back, Raiders pinned them down hard. During the retreat, the shaft collapsed, burying the entire team except for our guy. He himself was pinned against a wall by a support beam. The surface was just a couple hundred meters away, but without help, he had no chance of making it out alive. So he decided to hold on as long as he could. Two days later, he heard footsteps approaching. He recognized English speech, but by then he couldn’t even hold his pistol, let alone put up a fight. He saw a flashlight beam sweep the tunnel ahead and braced himself for the end. But instead of a gunshot, he heard a safety click, followed by careful steps. The newcomer wasn’t an enemy, but an ally. The stranger helped him get free, but the effort triggered heavy bleeding that his exhausted body couldn’t handle. What happened next he remembers only in fragments, drifting in and out of consciousness. All his strength went into holding onto that USEC, and at some point, he accidentally tore the patch off the stranger’s shoulder. He woke up in Therapist’s care, never finding out who had pulled him from the rubble. All he had left was the patch, which he now keeps with him. We often convince ourselves that we’re in control, but most things around us are shaped by forces we can’t predict – a lucky weather break during retreat, a weapon jam in the enemy’s hands, or the will of a random passerby. To everyone reading this: I wish you hope for a better outcome, even when everything seems set against you. That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.
68d2f44df63f06b7590ce30e_Note_Page1_Text: #19 Newspaper THE NINTH CIRCLE ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ Down the Untrodden Paths I welcome my readers once again. The Contract Wars have forever changed Tarkov’s landscape, and knowing the terrain often means the difference between life and death. Many turn to Jaeger for help, but the forester’s experience is of little use in urban areas or on the outskirts. Some of you may have heard of the Mushroom Picker who roams across the city, though few have ever met him in person. At one point, both the military and the Scavs were hunting the reclusive old man. It’s said the Mushroom Picker has no ties to TerraGroup and has never even held a weapon. Still, many would pay a fortune to have him on their side. That’s because the old man knows routes and passages that no one has walked, even in peaceful times. Somehow, the Mushroom Picker manages to avoid army checkpoints, not to mention Scav camps. With knowledge like that, he can seriously affect the balance of power in Tarkov. Yet no one has ever truly understood his motives or goals. The more devout citizens like to tell stories of his night-time encounters with witnesses of the Arrival. To be honest, I don’t rule anything out anymore. Despite his murky nature, the Mushroom Picker sometimes appears to those who’ve lost their way. I personally know several people, and they share nothing in common: he’s helped mercenaries from both PMCs, civilians, and even Scavs. Whatever moral compass guides this eccentric wanderer, his help is not something one can count on. A meeting with the Mushroom Picker only happens when he wills it. That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.

68d2fdbbf8817df4690db3d5_Note_Page1_Text: 000000 00ASSIFIED DESTROY AFTER READING 000000000 period: 000. 00, 0000 - Mar. 7, 2000 Research goals: 0000000 000 000000000000 00 00000 0000000000000 000000000000 0sing experimental compounds. During the reporting period 14 groups of test subjects were examined at the site. Each group contained between 5 and 25 people depending on the experimental conditions. Some experiments could not be carried out due to the site’s limited capabilities. Group 9 was redirected to Site Theta because of the risk of contamination and the poor containment of the “Labyrinth” premises. Group 1 had to be neutralized entirely for similar reasons. However, most experiments proved effective and provided the material and conclusions required by the laboratories and other test sites. Studies were conducted on effects on the human body and on expanding physical capabilities. Work proceeded along three directions: 1) Increasing organism endurance under various conditions. 2) Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body. 3) Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state. Increasing organism endurance under various conditions. During the study, subjects were placed in various conditions (food deprivation, prolonged confinement in a restricted space, blood loss exceeding 20/30/40% of total blood volume, burns with ITP from 50 to 95 points, acute and subacute intoxication). Compounds SJ6, eTG-c, and SJ1 demonstrated significant effectiveness in stabilizing condition and activating the organism’s reserve resources in poisoning of varying severity and intoxication in the presence of open wounds. Compounds SJ15 and M.U.L.E. demonstrated high effectiveness under favorable conditions and increased subjects’ activity periods by 47–60%. As a result of the studies, eTG-c, SJ6, and SJ15 are recommended for further iteration and development. The lack of professional training among test subjects negatively affected research results, therefore when used on trained combat personnel, the projected effect may reach higher results. Field testing is required.
68d2fdbbf8817df4690db3d5_Note_Page2_Text: HIGHLY CLASSIFIED DESTROY AFTER READING Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body. Extensive testing of already developed combat stimulants was carried out according to the established plan. Compounds P22 and M.U.L.E. exhibited critical side effects with regular use. Subjects were diagnosed with muscle tissue atrophy and, in isolated cases, paralysis or necrosis of individual muscles (3% of subjects). The research group associates these effects with excessive wear of muscle tissue and the organism’s inability to recover after such pressure. It is recommended to develop an advanced version of these compounds in which, after administration of the functional composition, a restorative mixture is also administered to replace expended physiological resources. Development of a new formulation of the compound Zagustin continues. Formulations that thinned the blood immediately after the action of the primary mixture were tested, but subjects exhibited symptoms similar to hemophilia. None of these subjects had a genetic predisposition to hemophilia, therefore the search for a more suitable formulation continues. In parallel a Zagustin-based compound with reduced effect on profibrinolysin activators is being developed. At present, Zagustin use is NOT RECOMMENDED due to an increased risk of thrombosis and stroke in the majority of subjects. Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state. The study did not confirm the possibility of deliberately inducing specific psychoses in subjects. Genetics and personal experience of subjects determined individual risk factors that limit the influence of specific compounds. Therefore a proposal emerged to develop, instead of receptor-targeted action, a compound that can influence the target’s central nervous system and cause the development of the psychoses to which the target has the greatest predisposition. Under the supervision of Voronenko N. V., two iterations of a general-purpose compound were tested. At present there is a problem with stabilizing the compound, and tests confirmed subject resistance to the compound. Deeper genomic study of subjects is required to identify

<width=75%><size=20>Apr. 14: The Bogatyr group intercepted intel on an upcoming USEC operation to evacuate a TerraGroup informant using surface vessels in the Gulf of Finland, near Vidny Island.

The group’s commander, callsign Voevoda, decided to intercept the target on his own initiative. In his personal report, Voevoda justified the decision by citing a lack of time for coordination and preparation of an official strike team.

The Bogatyrs set up an ambush near an abandoned barge by Vidny Island and successfully captured the informant. The enemy was eliminated with no casualties on the Bogatyr side. The informant was later extracted to the handoff point for a BEAR reserve unit.</size></width>
68d302814aae290cf704e375_Note_Page2_Text:
<width=75%><size=20>Mar. 25 - Mar. 27: The Bogatyr squad was assigned to locate and extract a TerraGroup asset. The target was not found at the designated coordinates, and due to radio silence, it was impossible to coordinate further actions with command.

According to the plan, the group was to withdraw and report mission failure. However, the commander (callsign Voevoda) chose to continue the search and successfully identified the asset’s new location.

From Mar. 26 to Mar. 27, the Bogatyr squad conducted surveillance on the convoy transporting the target and prepared for an assault. On Mar. 27, the asset was captured. The group then relocated and established a comms point to file the report. The commander confirmed multiple wounded and one KIA. Enemy forces were neutralized, and the asset was handed over to headquarters on Mar. 29.</size></width>
68d3037c91c2fa84e2044a0d_Note_Page1_Text:
<width=65%><align="center">Report</align>

On Jan. 2, the Bogatyr squad carried out a hostage evacuation from the Tarbank branch on Korablestroiteley Street. The enemy had taken up firing positions on the 1st and 2nd floors. Hostages were sheltered in the reception area on the 1st floor.

A direct assault was ruled out to minimize risk to the hostages. I decided to clear the building with two teams. The first team (call signs: Moreman, Kaskad) ascended to the 2nd floor using climbing gear and engaged the enemy utilizing smoke grenades.

Meanwhile, the main assault team (call signs: Voevoda, Taran, Vityaz), under sniper overwatch (call sign: Strelets), attacked the enemy on the 1st floor and extracted the hostages. The operation was completed swiftly, no hostages were injured. Fourteen targets were neutralized, presumably members of Kaban's criminal gang. No casualties in the Bogatyr squad.

The operation drew attention from nearby USEC forces and local civilians, and the squad had to repel enemy attacks twice during the withdrawal. After handing over the freed hostages to Russian Armed Forces, the Bogatyr squad will relocate from its previous bases to the Carousel outpost to await further instructions.

69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page1_Text: 12.11. Got out of Stockholm without any trouble. But during the layover the whole place turned into a complete fucking shitshow. Not only did they pull the entire crew off the ship and slow all work onboard to a crawl, they wouldn’t even let us stand nearby. And for what? With paranoia like that no wonder Terragroup rotates crews on the icebreaker so often. Short-ass contracts, all these fucked protocols, all this secrecy bullshit… nobody’d put up with this crap if the pay wasn’t insane. And I even managed to sneak a look at the loading op. They got people running back and forth nonstop and all they’re loading is crates full of electronics. Even the dockworkers are their own guys. Nobody GIVES A FUCK about your electronics, we’ve carried worse at sea! Arrogant fucking asshole fucks. 20.11 Made it to Tarkov, which means Saint Petersburg’s close now. Just hope we don’t get stuck here too like we did in Stockholm. Almost home.
69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page2_Text: 09.12 Wow what great fucking luck. They delayed the stopover while we were already approaching Tarkov, then canceled the whole thing completely. Heard something serious happened with Terragroup in the city, maybe even a shootout or some shit. If even half of it’s true, we’re gonna be sitting here for a long damn time. 15.01 Knew right away this was going to turn into a disaster… We’re fucked, royally. Orders came down from above to drop anchor and wait for further instructions and meanwhile everything in Tarkov just keeps getting worse. Alex says UN troops’ll enter the city soon and everything’ll calm down. Yeah, sure. Fucking sure it will… 3.06 Still no orders. Comms started acting up too. Usually at least you know when your contract ends, but here you just sit around losing your damn mind. Max’s family in Tarkov saw military vehicles in the streets. Maybe our guys’ll finally get shit under control??
69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page3_Text: April Thought I’d never even find this notebook again. And sure as hell never thought I’d end up trapped on this goddamn icebreaker for years. Fucking blockade… And that bastard Altman deserves worse than death! Yes the boys broke. We should’ve called for evacuation a long damn time ago! Maybe a year back those USECs still could’ve smuggled us across the cordon. Obvious enough command stopped giving a shit about us the second troops rolled into the city. But no. Altman’s precious materials matter more than actual living people whose brains are already melting in this frozen hell!

69bb45b89c92ecd910059159_Note_Page1_Text: Reports on the USEC Landing Operation in Tarkov 9/12/11 4:19 PM Following the incident at the TerraGroup main office in Tarkov, orders were issued to prepare Operation “Firefly”. The arrival of the container ships Kairo Nexus and Pacific Axis is expected within a week. All small craft required for the landing operation are already positioned in the waters off Tarkov. Eastern Energy is currently docked in the port of Saint Petersburg awaiting the order to initiate the operation. Pacific Axis has confirmed the presence of the following cargo categories and units on board: - LV type containers (light transport, civilian vehicles) - VM type containers (repair vehicles and maintenance equipment) - CM type containers (generators, camouflage nets, tents, heating stations, etc.) - CF type containers (communications equipment, radio-technical systems, electronics, surveillance equipment, encryption and intelligence equipment, etc.) - Fuel tank containers (IBC tanks) - LAV armored personnel carriers (12 units) - M1128 fire support vehicles (5 units) - Tigr armored vehicles (20 units) - Personnel (300 total) Kairo Nexus has confirmed the presence of the following cargo categories and units on board: - A/M type containers (ammunition for primary calibers and weapons systems, mines, etc.) - FS type containers (provisions for personnel) - MS type containers (medical equipment, instruments, etc.) - BM type containers (generators, camouflage nets, tents, heating stations, etc.) - GS type containers (household chemicals, hygiene supplies, etc.) - MB type containers (light watercraft) - Personnel (1200 total) 27/12/11 11:47 AM Kairo Nexus, Pacific Axis, and the small craft have taken their designated positions. Ice cover is minimal and does not impede vessel movement. The reconnaissance team (commander callsign Knight) deployed from Pacific Axis have successfully landed on the coast in the lighthouse peninsula area and established observation and communications posts.
